# Real Python

> Real Python is a comprehensive learning platform offering Python tutorials, interactive quizzes, structured learning paths, and AI-powered mentoring for developers of all skill levels.

Real Python provides expert-led educational content covering Python fundamentals, web frameworks (Django, Flask, FastAPI), career development, and modern Python practices. The platform combines tutorials, books, podcasts, community support, and personalized learning tools to help developers master Python programming.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Python 3
- Python Fundamentals
- Web Frameworks (Django, Flask, FastAPI)
- Skill Development
- Learning Paths
- Best Practices
- Career Development
- AI-Powered Learning
- Community
- Python Education
- Interactive Quizzes
- Code Mentoring
- Tutorial Index
- Structured Learning

## Getting Started & Learning Paths

- [Become a Python Expert](https://realpython.com/start-here): Real Python's complete learning system for Python skill development
- [Python Learning Paths](https://realpython.com/learning-paths): Structured Python learning roadmaps for beginner to advanced levels
- [Python Basics](https://realpython.com/tutorials/basics): Beginner-friendly tutorials on Python fundamentals and syntax
- [All Python Tutorial Topics](https://realpython.com/tutorials/all): Comprehensive index of Python tutorials organized by topic
- [Build Your Weekly Python Study Schedule](https://realpython.com/weekly-study-schedule): Guide to creating sustainable weekly Python study habits

## Learning Tools & Resources

- [Code Mentor: Intelligent Learning Tools](https://realpython.com/mentor): AI-powered code explanations and personalized learning recommendations
- [Python Quizzes](https://realpython.com/quizzes): Interactive Python quizzes to assess skills and track learning progress
- [Python Reference](https://realpython.com/ref): Python reference materials, glossary, and built-in functions
- [Python Books](https://realpython.com/products/books): Real Python books on Python fundamentals and best practices

## Specialized Learning Tracks

- [Python Career](https://realpython.com/tutorials/career): Interview prep and career development resources for Python developers
- [Python Coding With AI](https://realpython.com/tutorials/ai): Tutorials on Python with AI, LLMs, and RAG implementation

## Community & Support

- [Real Python Community Chat](https://realpython.com/community): Real Python Slack community for Pythonistas to learn and network
- [Office Hours](https://realpython.com/office-hours): Members-only live Q&A sessions with Real Python team
- [The Real Python Newsletter](https://realpython.com/newsletter): Weekly Python tips delivered via email newsletter
- [The Real Python Podcast](https://realpython.com/podcasts/rpp): Weekly Python podcast with interviews and coding tips

## Membership & Account

- [Membership](https://realpython.com/account/join): Real Python membership plans and subscription options
- [Learner Stories](https://realpython.com/learner-stories): Success stories of Pythonistas who leveled up with Real Python
